findings.explanation: The SPL has no stats, count or entity field; it returns one row per matching poll sample, and `the scheduled window` is an unfilled placeholder.
findings.suggested_fix: Say that each result row is one SNMP poll sample from one UPS (ups_name) where the replace indicator is yes, charge_pct is below 80 or runtime_min is below 15.

findings.explanation: The SPL also alerts when battery_replace_indicator is yes; the description omits that third condition.
findings.suggested_fix: List all three conditions, including battery_replace_indicator="yes".

findings.explanation: The scenarios cite count, span=1h and src, none of which exist in this SPL, and name no real UPS cause of a false alert.
findings.suggested_fix: Name real causes: charge_pct below 80 while batteries recharge after an outage or self-test, runtime_min dropping during a runtime calibration, and a freshly installed battery module reporting low charge or runtime.

findings.explanation: Splunk Connect for SNMP is normally a separate collector that sends to HEC, not an add-on installed on a Heavy Forwarder, and `SNMP TA (UPS-MIB)` is not a product name. The guide uses a Splunk Add-on for SNMP (3252) with an snmp:// stanza on a HF.
findings.quote: SNMP TA (UPS-MIB) collection via Splunk Connect for SNMP (Splunkbase app ID 6266) **or** SNMP Modular Input (Splunkbase app ID 1537) on a Heavy Forwarder
findings.suggested_fix: Check the SC4SNMP deployment model and the SNMP Modular Input install path, then describe each collection path separately and name the actual add-on. Compare with docs/guides/datacenter-physical.md.

findings.explanation: The reference is titled as SNMP Modular Input documentation, but 1537 is a community add-on; it is unclear that this Splunk docs path describes it.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the URL resolves to the intended add-on documentation; otherwise link the add-on's Splunkbase page or the SC4SNMP docs.

findings.explanation: The UC is built entirely on polled UPS-MIB gauges, with no trap handling in the SPL or implementation.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop snmp_trap, or document a trap-based path.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: Returns one row per matching poll sample with no latest-per-UPS reduction. A 15-minute alert window over 5-minute polls can emit several rows per UPS, and a recharging battery after an outage alerts as a fault.

summary: The implementation and detailedImplementation are reasonably specific to UPS-MIB battery polling, but the description, value, false-positive text and grandma line are template filler that describes a grouped count the SPL does not compute. One collection-path claim needs checking.
